excludedReasons..cursorrules / AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md: Upstream agent instructions, not ZN guidance. Deliberately not vendored so they can never be mistaken for ZN repo instructions.
excludedReasons..github/: Upstream CI. ZN CI stays ZN-owned.
excludedReasons..gitignore: Upstream repo hygiene, not needed for a vendored snapshot.
excludedReasons.assets/: Only the upstream project's own logo.svg plus a compliance README. The ZN shell does not need the upstream logo; excluding it avoids any trademark confusion. No proprietary binary asset was in assets/ (see README).
excludedReasons.package-lock.json: ZN does not install this directory as a separate package. The shell stage resolves peer deps from apps/desktop.

name: open-claude-ui

renamedFiles.UPSTREAM-CHANGELOG.md: Upstream CHANGELOG.md, content byte-identical, renamed for the same reason.
renamedFiles.UPSTREAM-README-en.md: Upstream README-en.md, content byte-identical, renamed for the same reason.
renamedFiles.UPSTREAM-README.md: Upstream README.md, content byte-identical, renamed so it cannot be mistaken for ZN's own README.

updateRule: To update: re-copy from a pinned upstream commit, update sourceCommit here, re-run diff -r against upstream plus the TypeScript verification, and never hand-edit a vendored file to change its look.
verbatimScope: Every file under src/, code-examples/, docs/ and scripts/ is byte-identical to the upstream commit above (verified with diff -r). No vendored component, token, or style was edited, renamed, or 'adapted'. The only filename changes in this directory are the three UPSTREAM-* prose renames listed above, whose contents are untouched.
